sources.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal production combat animation atlas. Transform the character from reference image 1 into a consistent full-body battle sprite; reference 1 is the ONLY identity source. Reference image 2 is only the established project cel-shaded chibi rendering and transparent-grid style; never copy its pangolin species, rice bowl or clothing. Subject: White fox spirit with long pointed ears, golden amber eyes, flowing white tail, ornate jade-and-gold forehead crown and earrings, cream and pale mint layered robes with black-gold chest and large oval jade pendant. Preserve the fox muzzle, white fur and regalia from reference 1. Style: polished original anime RPG cel shading, readable silhouette and clothing, about three heads tall, same species, face, apparent age, clothing palette and jewelry in every cell. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, SIXTEEN completely isolated full-body figures, regular equal square cells, square 1024x1024 canvas. All face three-quarter RIGHT. Uniform scale, feet on the same baseline within each cell. Each full silhouette including crown, antlers, wings, tail, staff and sleeves stays within its own cell with generous transparent gutters of at least 24 pixels. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, no grey/checkerboard, no stage/floor, no labels, letters, numbers, logos, UI, borders or grid lines. Do not reuse an identical pose. Keep effects small and attached to the hands/weapon, no huge circles, floor shadows, opaque aura or separate floating effects. Do not crop any figure. Layout is for sprites, not a portrait gallery. Rows from TOP to BOTTOM: row 1 idle, four varied breathing/blinking poses; row 2 walking, four visibly different alternating steps; row 3 attack, four consecutive frames: ready, windup, decisive contact, recovery; row 4 casting, four consecutive frames: prepare, gather, release, settle. Character-specific action direction: gentle upright breathing with tail sway; smooth biped walking with alternating feet and robe movement; quick right-paw swipe then open-palm contact and recoil; gather and release two slender white vapor ribbons from jade wrist ornaments. Exactly 16 poses, not 12 or 20.

NO spell VFX, magic ribbons, particles, halos, fog, cast circles, floor shadows, stage, UI, text, labels, grid lines, borders or other characters; runtime will provide effects.
